tableId.description: Optional owned table restriction. Omit to discover and join up to two personal tables using AUTO or PERSONAL. Explicit table selection requires SQL or AUTO mode and no guided plan.

source.description: AUTO discovers own table schemas before routing. PERSONAL restricts to own databases; DEMO explicitly selects sample commerce. Explicit guided plans are demo-only.

tableId.description: Present when one personal table was used. requestTableId records an explicit restriction; automatic queries may use two tables.

values.description: All defined fields; omit optional fields for NULL. Text <=4000 characters. Integer is signed bigint; decimal(18,4); date YYYY-MM-DD. PUT replaces all field values.

truncated.description: Connected preview exceeded 1000 records; total refers to preview count.

confirmation.description: Exact current name of the selected object, or row ID. Required for deletion.

connectionUrl.description: PostgreSQL URI; encrypted at rest, never returned. Only sslmode is accepted. Host must be allowlisted.
